method: Actual frozen source substrings run without edits in isolated Node vm. DOM/storage/AudioContext/OfflineAudioContext/object URL/file read/timer/RAF APIs are deterministic mocks. Source updateLabels, audio graph/await cancellation, handlers and pagehide/pageshow are actual functions. No full renderer is instantiated.

no_js.result: Noscript declares original Ember SVG background in reserved hero slot, hides JS moving host, and provides static explanation plus JavaScript-required notice.
no_js.browser_javascript_disabled: NOT_RUN; actual disabled-JS browser layout is not asserted

limits: SOURCE_VM is source-level control-flow evidence, not a browser permission-dialog, actual audio output, real file dialog, disk save, navigation-restoration timing, GPU or performance observation.
OfflineAudioContext cancellation discards its eventual result; harness does not claim cancellation stops native rendering computation.
Actual browser-generated WAV/JSON content, real normal interactions, BFCache/new-document restoration and source-bound performance are parent QA.
The harness does not execute WebGL renderer/placeSculpture or layout.
